assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have transformed precision measurement, reaching a regime that enables new tests and practical timekeeping.
assessment.attribution: Katori originated the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept; Ye made decisive experimental advances and broad metrological realization.
assessment.maturity: The technique is repeatedly demonstrated, highly reproducible, and internationally established.
uncertainties: The ultimate division of credit among the wider clock community requires careful historical scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry created an exceptionally powerful measurement platform for gravity, inertial sensing and fundamental tests.
assessment.attribution: Bordé supplied foundational interferometric concepts, while Kasevich delivered landmark operational demonstrations and applications.
assessment.maturity: Its core methods have been validated over decades and are now used across precision science.
uncertainties: Attribution spans several foundational beam-splitting and interferometry developments.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Squeezed light converted a quantum-optical principle into a demonstrable route beyond classical measurement noise.
assessment.attribution: Caves provided the decisive quantum-metrology framework; Mavalvala and Schnabel made central experimental contributions to usable squeezing.
assessment.maturity: Its deployment in gravitational-wave detectors is compelling confirmation of durable physical and instrumental impact.
uncertainties: The experimental development involved several closely connected laboratories.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Trapped-ion quantum computing and simulation established an experimentally precise architecture for controllable many-body quantum systems.
assessment.attribution: Cirac and Zoller framed influential protocols and architectures, while Blatt led defining experimental realizations.
assessment.maturity: High-fidelity control and scalable demonstrations make the field technically mature, even if large-scale computation remains unfinished.
uncertainties: Credit intersects with other important trapped-ion pioneers.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Single-NV-centre control made a robust solid-state quantum system into a versatile nanoscale sensor and quantum-optics platform.
assessment.attribution: Jelezko and Wrachtrup were central to establishing coherent single-defect spin control and its sensing consequences.
assessment.maturity: The methods are well replicated and have generated applications from magnetic imaging to quantum technologies.
uncertainties: The boundary between foundational spin control and later sensing applications is not sharp.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Semiconductor quantum-dot single-photon sources address a central requirement for photonic quantum technologies with unusually direct physical control.
assessment.attribution: The named scientists represent seminal conceptual and experimental advances in deterministic solid-state photon generation.
assessment.maturity: Source quality and integration have improved substantially, with broad experimental confirmation.
uncertainties: The contributions of many device-physics groups complicate a three-person attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recollision description gave strong-field physics an intelligible mechanism and underlies attosecond light generation.
assessment.attribution: Corkum's physical model and the theoretical developments of Lewenstein and Schafer form a coherent credited contribution.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has been extensively tested and its consequences are embedded in mature attosecond science.
uncertainties: The relation to prior and parallel high-harmonic-generation theory needs precise attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic-crystal fibres opened new regimes of guidance, dispersion engineering and nonlinear optics, enabling major experimental capabilities.
assessment.attribution: Russell, Knight and Birks made foundational conceptual and experimental contributions to the invention and development of the fibres.
assessment.maturity: The technology is long established, reproducible and influential in both fundamental research and instrumentation.
uncertainties: Its impact is distributed across a broad family of fibre designs and later applications.
